text:
Maya Ortiz: Quick sync on compact catalog rows — want to finalize the density toggle UX and the way performance badges + version pin appear. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyZZ (compact-density)
Sam Green: I prototyped two options: 1) inline pinned pill (no row expansion), 2) full expand (adds metadata row). Inline keeps height stable but hides details until expanded via a secondary action.
Zoe Kim: keyboard note: if the pill is focusable it becomes another tab stop. For compact mode we should default to a single tab stop per row and open details with Enter or context menu.
Priya Singh: screen reader snag — badges are read as "badge" only. Need aria-labels like: "Throughput: 95 requests per second; P95 latency 14 milliseconds; meets SLO." Visible tooltip can be short.
Noah White: visual shift issue: badges render after text and push the row. I suggest reserving a fixed width for the badge and using a skeleton element while data loads.
Maya Ortiz: agree on skeleton and reserved width. Also prefer inline pill for pinned versions in compact mode. It keeps the scan pattern consistent with dense rows.
Sam Green: copy proposals: visible tooltip -> "P95 14ms — within SLO". aria-label -> full sentence. Also change badge color semantics: green = within SLO, amber = borderline, red = violation.
Priya Singh: accessibility checklist I'll add: 1) badge announces full sentence; 2) pinned state announced (aria-pressed or aria-selected); 3) focus order stable; 4) no layout shift.
Zoe Kim: implementation plan: I'll update tab order so row is first, then inline pill only if expanded. Will test with VoiceOver and NVDA.
Noah White: QA: add Percy snapshot with throttled network to catch badge jumps, and a keyboard-only pass to check hit targets. Increase pin hit area to 32px.
Maya Ortiz: timeline: Sam will upload updated frames by EOD, Zoe aims to open PR tomorrow. Priya will run a11y validation after merge. Any objections to the short tooltip text? :thumbsup:
All: :thumbsup:
